option.name: --check-hash-based-pycs
tip: control how Python invalidates hash-based .pyc files

next.name: always
tip: always invalidates hash-based .pyc files

next.name: never
tip: never invalidates hash-based .pyc files

option.name: --help-all
tip: print complete help information and exit

option.name: --help-env
tip: print help about Python environment variables and exit

option.name: --help-xoptions
tip: print help about implementation-specific -X options and exit

option.name: --version
tip: print the Python version number and exit
when given twice, print more information about the build

option.name: -b
tip: issue warnings about converting bytes/bytearray to str and comparing
bytes/bytearray with str or bytes with int. (-bb: issue errors)

option.name: -B
tip: don't write .pyc files on import;
also PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=x

option.name: -c
tip: Program passed in as string (terminates option list)

option.name: -d
tip: turn on parser debugging output (for experts only, only works on debug builds);
also PYTHONDEBUG=x

option.name: -E
tip: ignore PYTHON* environment variables (such as PYTHONPATH)

option.name: -i
tip: inspect interactively after running script;
forces a prompt even if stdin does not appear to be a terminal;
also PYTHONINSPECT=x

option.name: -I
tip: isolate Python from the user's environment (implies -E, -P and -s)

option.name: -m
tip: Run library module as a script (terminates option list)

option.name: -O
tip: remove assert and __debug__-dependent statements;
add .opt-1 before .pyc extension; also PYTHONOPTIMIZE=x

option.name: -OO
tip: do -O changes and also discard docstrings;
add .opt-2 before .pyc extension

option.name: -P
tip: don't prepend a potentially unsafe path to sys.path;
also PYTHONSAFEPATH

option.name: -q
tip: don't print version and copyright messages on interactive startup

option.name: -s
tip: don't add user site directory to sys.path; also PYTHONNOUSERSITE

option.name: -S
tip: don't imply 'import site' on initialization

option.name: -u
tip: force the stdout and stderr streams to be unbuffered
this option has no effect on stdin; also PYTHONUNBUFFERED=x

option.name: -v
tip: verbose (trace import statements)
also PYTHONVERBOSE=x can be supplied multiple times to increase verbosity

option.name: -W
tip: Warning control; arg is action:message:category:module:lineno, also PYTHONWARNINGS=arg

option.name: -x
tip: skip first line of source, allowing use of non-Unix forms of #!cmd

option.name: -X
tip: Set implementation-specific option

global_option.name: --help
tip: print this help message and exit
